caption: The drawing features a single, vertically oriented object resembling a decorative mirror or window with a pointed, arch-like top. The main body of the object is filled with a shaded gray-blue area, suggesting a reflective or glass surface. Surrounding this central area is an ornate frame composed of sections adorned with patterns in shades of pink, gold, and light coral, featuring geometric shapes and floral motifs. The corners and apex of the frame are accentuated with gray decorative elements that have a lacy or floral appearance. To the right of the main object, near the upper right corner of the composition, is a minimal, rectangular outline with a horizontal division in the center, also shaded in light gray-blue, possibly representing a simplified window or panel. The background is plain and uncolored, with no additional elements. The entire composition is rendered on a cream-colored surface, and the drawing appears to be executed in pencil and watercolor. In the lower right corner, there is a small, handwritten text that seems to be a signature.
title: Nicho
